job.title: Staff AI Engineer - Agent Evaluation Platform

strengths: Built LLM-as-a-judge evaluation methods for Turkish summarization
Led AI evaluation research in medical NLP projects
8 years of software engineering experience with Python and full-stack development
gaps: No explicit experience building large-scale production CI/CD pipelines for AI tooling
Limited background in regulated medical device software development

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer with a PhD focus on trustworthy AI and medical NLP. At Toros University I designed and ran evaluation pipelines that used LLM-as-a-judge, human review and statistical sampling to assess Turkish summarisation models. This work directly matches EvalX's goal of building shared evaluation capabilities for AI agents.

My software background spans full-stack web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP) and Python-based AI research. I co-founded a technology centre where I managed projects that turned research prototypes into usable tools, and I have coordinated international academic activities, which required close collaboration with diverse teams.

I have published on human-centered evaluation metrics for clinical AI and presented at the ELSA Trustworthy AI workshop. These experiences give me a practical view of how evaluation methods can be integrated into product workflows and adopted by engineers.

I look forward to helping Doctolib turn evaluation into a core engineering practice and to contributing to safer, more reliable healthcare AI.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
short_pitch: I design and operate AI evaluation pipelines, including LLM-as-judge and human review, for medical NLP projects. With eight years of software engineering experience, I turn research into production tools that teams can adopt.

answers.why_this_role: The role combines platform engineering with AI evaluation, exactly what I have done in my research on trustworthy NLP and in building evaluation tools for medical text summarisation.
answers.why_this_organisation: Doctolib's focus on improving healthcare through technology matches my work on AI systems that support clinicians and patients, especially in the medical domain.
answers.relevant_experience: I led the development of evaluation frameworks that used LLM-as-judge, deterministic checks and human feedback for Turkish summarisation models, and I have managed software projects from prototype to deployment.
answers.research_interests: My research explores explainable and trustworthy AI for clinical applications, hybrid evaluation metrics, and how AI can assist healthcare professionals safely.
answers.additional_information: I have coordinated international academic activities and mentored students, showing I can work across teams and drive adoption of new practices.
